primary_interest.quote: So my understanding is you want voice AI agents for appointment booking.

use_case.quote: Patients call, the agent finds a slot, confirms, maybe reschedules.

inference_framing.quote: I don't want to buy an inference API separately, to be clear. I only care about it as the thing that makes the agent work.

inference_raised_by.quote: And where does the model come in? I'm assuming the LLM sits behind this.

competitors_inference.quote: we're also looking at OpenAI direct for the model side

competitors_voice.quote: We've been using Plivo for some outbound reminders.

decision_criteria.quote: We need to swap between several open models. Qwen 2.5 72B and Mistral Large are the two we're testing, and I don't want to be locked into one.

stated_reason.quote: The other big one is data residency. We're a healthcare company, patient data, so it has to stay in the UK.
